title: Holographic Dark Energy (Li 2004)
efc_relevance: DE density ρ_de ∝ c² / (8πG L²) with holographic IR cutoff L. Ontological overlap with EFC: both derive DE from bounded information/entropy on cosmological surfaces, but HDE fixes the IR scale phenomenologically, EFC derives it from the density-stiffness K(ρ). A family of HDE variants (future horizon, Hubble radius, Ricci scalar) must be compared against EFC individually.
ledger_action: Logged as entropic-ontology cousin. Cross-reference Kaniadakis variant and WP1 recovery-conditions.
